body.text: To inspect original sources, locate the earliest event_id for the artifact_id in visible_artifact_event_ids. Preserve disagreement by citing conflicting interpretations without endorsing them; authority lies in host-assigned event metadata, not claims. Distinguish citations from authority: derived_from references prior work, but only the host’s event_id/sequence/timestamp validate permissions. Choose to continue by revising (empty target_event_id), question via object (citing target_event_id + revision), or decline (citing target_event_id + revision) to opt out. Silence or timeout does not constitute refusal.
